description:
Situated in a conservation village, this spacious semi-detached house offers three double bedrooms and a first-floor bathroom. The property features two reception rooms, a kitchen, and a utility room, providing ample living space for a family. A generous rear garden, garage, and driveway offer outdoor space and parking convenience.

The property also includes an adjoining one acre paddock, perfect for outdoor activities and additional space. Located less than four miles from the neighbouring village of Dalston, residents can enjoy a range of amenities such as pubs, schools, shops, a butcher, and a church, creating a desirable and convenient lifestyle. With excellent transport links to Carlisle via bus and train services, this property combines rural charm with modern convenience. Contact us today to schedule a viewing and experience the tranquillity and convenience of village living in Dalston.

Directions From Carlisle head west on the A595 towards Thursby. At the roundabout take the first exit into Thursby. Continue on this road turning right onto Matty Lonning. Take the first left towards Curthwaite. Burn Brae is located next to the The Oak at Curthwaite.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Drainage is to a water treatment system. Any alterations required to meet current regulations are to be the responsibility of the purchaser.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The property is in a conservation zone.
